tokens.name: row-alt

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Badge borders for non-default evidence, chip and control borders. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. A cool slate, softer than black; 12:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, retrieval dates, column notes. 5.7:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interface only: links, citations, sort state, active filters, focus. Never a project. 6:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Bring your own distro column, row hover and active chip. accent text 5.9:1 on it (light).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid accent fill (active filter chip).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links: accent with an underline.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with a 2px offset.

tokens.name: flag-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the Fact-fix flag and the illustrative banner. Marks review state, never a project.

tokens.name: flag-ink
tokens.usage: Text on flag-bg. 7.2:1 (light), 9.5:1 (dark).

tokens.name: flag-rule
tokens.usage: Border of the flag and banner. 3.2:1 or more on every surface.
